question: Should OpenClaw adopt memory role slots as a core/plugin API direction, or keep the current single-memory-slot model and solve these use cases through narrower plugin contracts?
rationale: VISION.md currently describes memory as one special active plugin slot, while the issue and comments show real multi-provider demand that likely needs new core/plugin config semantics.

options.title: Review the role-slot PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the concrete architecture candidate, but require conflict resolution and compatibility proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to API/RFC first
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for a smaller design that names the minimal plugin API and migration surface before implementation continues.

options.title: Keep one memory slot
options.body: Reject the multi-slot direction for now and document the supported workaround or recommended default memory path instead.

recommendation.title: Review the role-slot PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the concrete architecture candidate, but require conflict resolution and compatibility proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied by blame to the current slot/runtime implementation surface that the product decision would change.
